questions.question: What does Ezekiel 45 set apart as a holy portion of the land?
options: A pasture for the flocks of the prince
A holy district for the sanctuary and the priests
A great marketplace for the trade of all the nations
A fortress to guard the eastern border
questions.answer: A holy district for the sanctuary and the priests

questions.question: What does God command the princes of Israel to do in Ezekiel 45?
options: Collect far heavier tribute from the people
Build a grander palace than the temple
Put away violence and use honest weights
Gather a great army to defend the land
questions.answer: Put away violence and use honest weights

questions.question: Ezekiel 45 prescribes just measures: an honest ephah and an honest bath.
Put away violence and oppression, O princes of Israel, and do what is just and _____.
You shall have just balances, a just _____, and a just bath.
